meta.title: Steven Espinoza · Fast websites that sell
meta.description: Online stores, restaurant sites, premium brand sites and SaaS landings that load instantly and win people over in the first 10 seconds. Live demos.

hero.title: Websites that win the room before you finish the pitch.
hero.lead: I'm Steven Espinoza, a software engineer. I design and build online stores, restaurant sites, premium brand sites and SaaS landings that load fast, feel like an app and are made to sell.

gallery.title: Four demos, four industries
gallery.lead: Each with its own identity. Open them on your phone: that's how your customers will see them.

items.title: Fast to launch
items.body: A first version live in days, not months. We start from proven patterns and shape them to your brand.

items.title: Fast to load
items.body: Every page is measured with Lighthouse on mobile: LCP under 2.5 s, no layout jumps and instant response to taps.

items.title: Smooth to use
items.body: No reloads, blank screens or new tabs: cart, filters and bookings open on the same page.

showcase.title: Watch a demo come together, layer by layer
showcase.body: A scripted simulation of the process: design, frontend, copy and QA put one of the demos together in front of you, from wireframe to animations.

cta.title: Does your business need a site like this?
cta.body: Tell me what you sell and to whom. I'll reply with a concrete proposal.

gate.caption: A team of agents is about to build this page in front of you. It's a scripted simulation.
